toastPasteImageFailed: Couldn’t paste the image: {error}. Try again, or drop the image file on the pane.
toastPasteImageDenied: Couldn’t paste the image: guios can’t write to {dir}. Make it writable, or drop the image file on the pane.
toastPasteImageDiskFull: Couldn’t paste the image: the disk is full. Free some space and try again.
toastPasteClipboardUnreadable: Couldn’t read the clipboard. Copy it again and paste.
toastPasteImageUnsupported: Couldn’t paste the image: {format} isn’t supported. Copy it as PNG or JPEG, or drop the image file on the pane.
toastConfigProblems: {count, plural, one {Your config has # problem: see Settings › Advanced} other {Your config has # problems: see Settings › Advanced}}
cliInstallFailed: Couldn’t install the command line tool
cliAddedToPath: Added the tuios command to your PATH: new terminals have it
openProjectMessage: Choose a folder: its sessions are grouped under its name.
confirmCloseSessionDetail: {process} is still running in it. Closing the session ends it.
confirmCloseProjectDetail: {count, plural, one {This ends its # session, with what runs in it.} other {This ends its # sessions, with what runs in them.}}
confirmCloseAllSessionsDetail: {count, plural, one {The project stays. Its # session ends, with what runs in it.} other {The project stays. Its # sessions end, with what runs in them.}}
confirmClosePaneDetail: {process} is still running in it. Closing the pane ends it.
confirmQuitAllDetail: {count, plural, one {guios keeps sessions running when it quits. This ends the # session, with what runs in it.} other {guios keeps sessions running when it quits. This ends all # of them, with what runs in them.}}
restartRunning: {count, plural, one {A program is running in # session} other {Programs are running in # sessions}}
restartStaleDetail: The service that runs your sessions is still guios {was}, and this is guios {version}. {running}: restarting ends them, and sessions start again where they were, with their history.
restartServiceDetail: The program in each pane ends. The shells start again in their folders, below their history.
footerNeedsYou: {count, plural, one {# session needs you} other {# sessions need you}}
footerWorking: {count, plural, one {# session working} other {# sessions working}}
footerDone: {count, plural, one {# session done, unseen} other {# sessions done, unseen}}
footerServiceTip: Sessions run in the tuios daemon, in the background: they keep running when you quit guios.
updateRestartTip: The tuios daemon is from another version. Restart it to run this version.
updatedDetail: The tuios daemon that runs your sessions is from another version. Restart it. Your sessions start again where they were, with their history.
emptyDetail: Sessions run in the tuios daemon. Quit guios and come back to everything as you left it.
paletteRestartServiceDetail: Sessions start again where they were
palettePlaceholder: Find a session, a pane or a command…
paletteNoConversations: No conversations yet. Agents’ conversations show here after you set up the tuios integration for them in Agents.
paletteAgents: Show or hide the agents view
svcRunning: Running, version {version} (pid {pid}) · {sessions, plural, one {# session} other {# sessions}}, {panes, plural, one {# pane} other {# panes}}
svcStale: · still an earlier guios: restart it to update
setSessionsDetail: Sessions keep running in the background when guios quits. {action} ends them.
setSessionNameDetail: Until you or an agent name one. With Pane you’re in, a pane running only its shell defers to the pane that needs you most.
setSidebarRowsDetail: Detailed rows add a line under each session’s name: its status message, else its branch and changes.
setFocusFollowsMouseDetail: A pane takes the focus when the pointer moves into it, without a click.
setAskBeforeClosing: Ask before closing a running program
setAskBeforeClosingDetail: When a pane or session you close has a program other than the shell running.
setKeepHistoryDetail: The tuios daemon saves each pane’s history with its session. After a restart, the history shows again above a new shell.
setResumeAgentsDetail: What the tuios daemon does with each agent’s conversation when it starts again. Ask puts an item in the Inbox. Auto resumes it.
setAppIconDetail: Closing the window keeps guios running in the menu bar.
setAutoCheckDetail: Once a day, while guios is open.
setAutoInstallDetail: They take effect the next time guios opens.
setTranslucentDetail: Let the desktop show through the window’s background.
setDimUnfocusedDetail: When a session has several panes, the terminals you’re not in fade.
setFontDetail: JetBrains Mono with Nerd Fonts icons comes with guios. Any installed monospaced font works. To give more than one font, separate the names with commas. guios uses the first installed one.
setLigaturesDetail: Join characters as the font draws them, as => and !=.
setThickenDetail: A heavier stroke, as Ghostty’s font-thicken.
setColorsDetail: One of Ghostty’s themes, or your own in ~/.config/ghostty/themes, colors the window, its panes and terminals in place of the theme above.
setOptionMetaDetail: Option sends Alt to programs, as for Emacs and readline, instead of typing accents.
setCopyOnSelectDetail: What you select goes to the clipboard.
setClipboardReadDetail: As with OSC 52: agents asking for what you copied.
setWheelScrollDetail: How far a notch of the wheel scrolls.
setTrackpadScrollDetail: How fast scrolling with two fingers goes.
setShellGroupDetail: Changes apply to new panes. The shell is in tuios’s config.toml, so the TUI uses it too.
setScrollbackDetail: How much history guios keeps for each pane it shows. The tuios daemon keeps the full history.
setEnvironmentDetail: Added to every pane’s, over what guios sets (TERM, TUIOS_SESSION…).
setNotifyUnpackaged: This build can’t post notifications: macOS shows those of packaged apps only.
setNotifyWaitingDetail: A program asks something, rings the bell, or reports it is blocked.
setNotifyDoneDetail: While you look at another session, or another app.
setDockBadgeDetail: With the number of sessions that need you.
setDockBounceDetail: Once, when a session comes to need you.
setRemoteControlDetail: tuios do and tuios focus run the app’s actions, as its menus do: splitting, switching sessions, opening the palette. tuios browser clicks, types and reads in browser panes.
setCliDetail: Inside guios, every pane has the tuios command on its PATH already.
setCliNotInstalled: Not installed: other terminals don’t know the tuios command.
setSkillsDetail: The tuios integration tells the daemon what each agent does: working, waiting for you, or done. It also lets agents drive their panes.
setProgramStatusDetail: Programs report what they do with OSC 7501, Superlogical’s program status protocol: the sidebar shows it, and notifies you.
setConfigurationDetail: Each setting here is a line of this file, as in Ghostty. Edit it in any editor. What you save applies at once.
setBackgroundServiceDetail: The tuios daemon runs your sessions. It keeps running when you quit guios.
setDataDetail: The settings and window state of guios. Sessions and their history are in the tuios daemon.
setResetDetail: Back to how guios comes, shortcuts included.
setKeyboardHelp: Click a shortcut, then type the new one. Press Delete to remove it. Press Escape to keep it.
setShortcutNeedsMac: A shortcut needs ⌘, ⌃ or ⌥, unless it is a function key.
setShortcutNeedsPc: A shortcut needs Ctrl or Alt, unless it is a function key.
filesDeleteFolderTitle: Delete the folder “{name}” and everything in it?
filesDeleteTrashDetail: You can restore it from the Trash.
filesDeleteRecycleDetail: You can restore it from the Recycle Bin.
filesDeleteForGoodDetail: It's deleted for good: this host has no trash to move it to.
changesTurnTip: What the agent changed since it last started working
changesUncommittedTip: What isn't committed, untracked files too
changesBranchTip: What this branch changed since it left {branch}
changesNoneTurn: The agent hasn't changed any files since it started working.
changesNoRepoDetail: A session's changes show here while it works in a git repository.
changesGitOffDetail: Turn on Show git status in Settings to see the changes here.
changesRevertTip: Put the old lines back in the file
viewerSaveOne: Do you want to save the changes you made to “{name}”?
viewerSaveMany: {count, plural, one {Do you want to save the changes you made to # file?} other {Do you want to save the changes you made to # files?}}
viewerSaveDetail: Your changes will be lost if you don't save them.
viewerConflictDetail: It changed since you opened it. Overwrite it with your version, or discard your changes for the file as it is now.
setGitDetail: Branches and changes of the repositories sessions work in.
setGitStatusDetail: Each session's branch and changes, by its panes' titles and in the sidebar.
setDiffLayoutDetail: Auto shows diffs unified while their card is narrow, and side by side once it's wide.
setBlockAdsDetail: Blocks ads and trackers with filter lists, which guios downloads and keeps up to date.
setAdListEasylist: Ads, the list most blockers start from.
setAdListPeterLowe: Ad and tracker servers, by their domains.
setAdListFanboyAnnoyance: Pop-ups, newsletter prompts and chat boxes, and the cookie and social lists' too.
setAdListsNote: Lists hide more as they add up, and may break a page now and then. Lists of other URLs go in the configuration, as browser-filter-list.
changesUnmodified: {count, plural, one {# unmodified line} other {# unmodified lines}}
hostAuthHint: guios signs in with your SSH keys and agent, and never asks for a password. To trust a host's key, run ssh {address} once in a terminal.
hostRemoveDetail: Its sessions keep running on {host}. Add the machine again to see them.
hostUpdateDetail: guios copies the tuios of this computer to {host} and restarts its daemon. The programs in its panes stop.
hostUpdateAppDetail: The guios app on {host} updates and relaunches, then restarts its service. Sessions there start again where they were, with their history, and the programs running in them end.
hostUpdateDev: A development build of guios can't update a host. Run a released guios, or update the host with tuios daemon update there.
hostVersionDetail: {host} runs tuios {version}, and this computer runs tuios {app}. Update tuios there to see its sessions here.
hostDesktopDetail: {host} runs the guios app, version {version}, and this is guios {app}. Update guios on {host}, or turn on Let them update guios there (Settings › Hosts) to update it from here.
hostRestartDetail: Sessions on {host} start again where they were, with their history, and the programs running in them end.
hostStaleTip: The service on {host} still runs guios {was}, and guios {version} is installed there: restart it to run the new version.
pasteNotAFile: guios pastes files into a pane on another machine, not folders: {name}
pasteTooLarge: guios pastes at most {size} MB into a pane on another machine
pickerPlaceholder: Filter folders, or type a path: ~/code
pickerHint: ↩ go in · {open} open the folder chosen
setHostsDetail: The machines that the tuios daemon of this computer links over ssh. Their sessions show in the sidebar under Machines. The command tuios hosts shows the same list.
setHostsNoneDetail: Add a machine that you reach with ssh. If it has no tuios, guios offers to install it.
setHostAddDetail: Type the ssh address, such as me@devbox, or a host name from your ~/.ssh/config. The name is what guios and tuios call the machine.
setHostRemoteControlDetail: Let programs on {host} show sessions and run the app's actions (tuios focus, tuios do)
setListenDetail: The tuios daemon listens at this computer's Tailscale addresses, for guios on your other machines. Only your Tailscale account may connect.
setListenOn: Add this computer as a host on your other machines at this address. Only your Tailscale account may connect.
setListenNoTailscale: Tailscale isn't running here: the tuios daemon listens once it is.
setRemoteUpdatesDetail: guios on your other machines can update this app to its version. The app relaunches, and the programs running in its sessions end.
setHostSettingsSplitDetail: The shell, environment, scrollback and session restore of a host's sessions come from its own configuration: run tuios config edit on the host. Appearance, keyboard and notifications are this app's.
setShellThisComputer: These apply to this computer's sessions. Each host's come from its own configuration (Settings › Hosts).
confirmQuitAllHosts: Sessions on other machines keep running.
hostInstallDetail: guios copies the tuios of this computer to {host} and starts its daemon. Nothing on {host} stops.
hostLinkRefused: guios opens only web links of {host}, not {scheme} ones
hostManualDetail: {host} runs guios {version}, and this app is guios {app}. Update guios on {host} as you installed it, then restart its service.
hostNewerDetail: {host} runs guios {version}, newer than this app's {app}. Update this app to see and start the host's sessions.
hostSameAs: This host's the tuios daemon is {other}'s, which the app shows already
browserBlank: Type an address or a search above
worktreeDetailDefault: guios checks out a new branch from the default branch in a folder of its own, so the session’s agent works apart from the others.
worktreeDetailCurrent: guios checks out a new branch from the current branch in a folder of its own, so the session’s agent works apart from the others.
worktreeRemoveMerged: Its folder {path} goes, and its branch {branch}, which is merged.
worktreeRemoveUnmerged: Its folder {path} goes. Its branch {branch} stays, with its commits.
worktreeRemoveDirty: {count, plural, one {# changed file} other {# changed files}} in {path} will be lost. Its branch {branch} stays, with its commits.
setSessionHistoryDetail: List the coding agents' ended conversations in the sidebar, to resume them later or archive them.
endedDeleteAllDetail: guios forgets them. Each agent keeps its own history of the conversation.
endedSetUpSkill: Set up the tuios integration for your agents to list their ended conversations here
toastGlobalShortcutFailed: Couldn’t use {keys} for the quick terminal: {error}
cockpitEmptyDetail: Run claude, codex or another agent in any pane. tuios finds it and shows it here.
cockpitJustChanged: This prompt just changed. Read it, then answer.
cockpitWasTyping: You were typing. Press the key again to answer.
cockpitNoReason: This agent takes no reason with a reject. Press r to reject it.
cockpitNotHuman: The daemon does not accept guios as you. Open guios outside every tuios pane.
cockpitNoTranscriptDetail: tuios has not found this agent's transcript. Install the integration for its harness, or wait for its first turn.
cockpitPickAgentDetail: Its conversation, changes and mail show here.
cockpitPressAgain: This command is risky. Press {key} again within 3 seconds to allow it.
cockpitReasonPlaceholder: Type the reason, then press Enter to reject
cockpitScreenPrompt: Answers the prompt on the pane's screen
cockpitSettled: {name} is settled. Press u to undo.
cockpitSettleOnlyAgent: Only an agent can be settled. Dismiss or snooze this row.
cockpitShowAllLines: {count, plural, one {Show all # line} other {Show all # lines}}
cockpitSnoozeOnlyItem: Only an Inbox item can be snoozed.
cockpitAnswerInPane: tuios cannot read this prompt on the screen. Open the pane to answer it.
cockpitReplyPlaceholder: Write a reply. Paste or drop an image to add it.
cockpitTooManyImages: A message takes at most {n} images.
cockpitNowNoImages: Images go only with a queued message. Press Enter to queue it.
cockpitQueuedFor: {name} gets the message when it rests.
cockpitFilesChanged: {count, plural, one {# file changed} other {# files changed}}
cockpitNotePlaceholder: Write a note for the agent, then press Enter
cockpitNoCheckpointsDetail: tuios keeps one when a turn ends in a git worktree.
cockpitNoMailDetail: Mail to and from {name} shows here.
cockpitPassMail: Pass the mail to the agent
cockpitCardPlaceholder: What is the card? Press Enter to add it
cockpitTakeNeedsAgent: Select an agent of the card's session first.
usageNotSupported: This system does not report the usage of panes.
usageNoDaemon: The daemon does not report usage. Update tuios to see it.
workspaceEmptyDetail: Open a pane here, or go to another workspace.
setTuiosKeysDetail: In a pane, press the tuios prefix key (Ctrl+B by default) to open the tuios menus. Press Ctrl+P to open the command palette. Your tuios config.toml sets the keys.
keysNeedTui: Open this session in the tuios TUI to use this key.
setFontMissing: {font} is not installed or not monospaced. guios uses its own font.
hostQueued: {count, plural, one {# message waits} other {# messages wait}} for the link
hostStartFailed: Could not start the daemon on {host}: {error}
lookTooLarge: The file is too large to show.
lookUnreadable: The file could not be read.
lookPictureUnreadable: The picture could not be read.
lookNoDecoder: This machine cannot read this picture. Install ImageMagick or ffmpeg.
lookNoPoppler: This machine has no {tool} to draw PDF pages. Install poppler and open the file again.
lookNoFfmpeg: This machine has no {tool}. Install ffmpeg to see this file.
lookNoBsdtar: This machine has no {tool} to list this archive.
lookPDFLocked: The PDF is locked with a password.
lookPageFailed: This page could not be drawn.
lookNoFrame: No frame could be read here.
lookSVGUnsupported: guios cannot draw this SVG. Its source is in the Source view.
lookNotJSON: The file is not valid JSON.
lookCounting: The lines are still being counted. Try again in a moment.
lookTableCapped: Shows the first {count} rows. The file has more.
lookJSONCapped: Shows the start of the file. It is too large to read whole.
lookFindHint: Text to find. Lower case ignores case.
actionLayoutScrollExpel: Move last pane to own column
layoutSnapNeedsFloating: Turn tiling off to snap a pane.
cockpitReadingPrompt: tuios is still reading the prompt. Press the key again.
cockpitAnswerFailed: tuios could not send the answer. Open the pane to answer it.
toastPaneTooSmall: This pane is too small to split. Close a pane or make the window wider.
copyModeHint: Move with h, j, k and l. Press v to select and y to copy. Press q to leave.
helpPlaceholder: Find a key or what it does…
helpFooter: Your tuios config.toml sets the tuios keys. Settings, Keyboard sets the guios keys. Press Esc to close.
promptRenamePaneDetail: Every client shows this name. Leave it empty to show the program's title again.
promptRenameWorkspaceDetail: The workspace keeps its number. Leave the name empty to show the number again.
promptNoteDetail: One short line: what the session is for, or what comes next. Leave it empty to remove the note.
keysNothingFinished: No finished turn waits for you.
keysNoBuffer: There is no paste buffer. A copy in copy mode makes one.
keysPickPathTitle: Type the path of a file
keysNest: Every key goes to the pane now, {leader} too. Press {key} to leave.
copyModeHintsHint: Type a label to copy its text. Press Esc to leave.
copyModeNoHints: Nothing on the screen to label.
keysNoTransfers: No copies between machines yet. Copy a file to another machine from the Files tab.
keysCalmOn: Calm mode is on. Nothing moves or blinks, and only what needs you notifies.
keysCalmOffHeld: Calm mode is off. It held {n} notifications.
keysTapeSkipped: Played {name}. Commands only the TUI runs were left out: {n}.
scrollbackNoMarks: This pane's shell does not mark its commands. Set up the tuios shell integration to use the scrollback browser.
scrollbackFooter: j and k move. J and K scroll the output. y copies the output, c the command. Enter types the command again. / filters. Esc closes.
